title.narrative: Second Decentralized Public Service and Financial Management Sector Development Program, Subprogram 1

description.narrative: The proposed sector development program (SDP) combines a PBL with an investment component to support key reforms in public financial management (PFM) and decentralization. The PBL adopts a programmatic approach to strengthen subnational fiscal planning, PFM, and public administration. This enables the sequencing of reforms and phased support from the Asian Development Bank (ADB) to improve service delivery and bridge the urban–rural divide. The programmatic approach builds on ADB’s ongoing first Decentralized Public Service and Financial Management Sector Development Program. The project component will operationalize the National School of Local Administration (NASLA) to provide sustainable capacity development for staff of subnational administrations (SNAs).
